description: The new histogram wrapper permits zero bins although counting requires a valid bin.
trigger: Call histogram with nonempty contiguous CUDA float input, an empty kLong output, min_value=0, max_value=1 and exclusive=false.
expected_behavior: Reject the zero-bin output before launching.
actual_behavior: The sole bin-count guard accepts zero. For an input value of zero, idx becomes zero, the unsigned comparison succeeds, and num_bins-1 underflows before assignment to idx; the subsequent atomic update has no valid initialized histogram bin. Reach is direct extension callers; no parent-tree callers of the new utility were found.

verification.description: Traced output.numel() through the upper-bound-only check, shared-memory initialization and index clamp.
verification.limits: No malformed CUDA invocation was executed; the resulting device error or memory effect is unmeasured.
